items.excerpt: Pixel Watch 4 update brings Google's generative AI watch face generator (previously a Pixel Watch 5 feature) to last year's watch, along with other additions.
9to5Google reports a next-generation Google TV Streamer is in development with built-in microphones, presence sensing and a new remote, pointing to a hands-free Gemini-for-Home living-room device.
XREAL's first Android XR glasses, XREAL Aura, get official pricing starting at $1,279, putting Google's Gemini-powered XR platform into a shipping glasses product.
The Verge's staff share four notes after a week testing Gemini-first Googlebook laptops, finding the hardware solid but the AI-centric software vibes 'a bit off.'
TechRadar reviews MSI's Pro Max Edge AI+, a mini PC built for local AI with AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395, Radeon 8060S graphics and a 50-TOPS NPU, praising its offline AI performance.
Pre-orders are now live for Nvidia RTX Spark laptops starting at $2,599; TechRadar picks three Blackwell-powered machines for running local AI.
Tom's Guide tests Nvidia's claim that RTX Spark AI laptops deliver the same performance plugged in and on battery, and finds the claim holds up.
PCWorld reviews the Acer Googlebook 14: a great premium laptop whose Gemini-powered Magic Pointer turned out less annoying than expected, though the AI isn't its best part.
Hisense rolls out its AI Companion Suite through the PureSmart Duo refrigerator series, positioning the AI fridge as the intelligent hub of a 'social kitchen' (PR Newswire release).
At AI Festa 2026 in Seoul, AnalogPlus, P&C Solution and Rhinos showed on-device AI gadgets, including XR glasses, built on Korean NPUs from Telechips, DeepX and Deeper-I.
Dell, Microsoft and others are launching laptops built on Nvidia's RTX Spark superchip, opening a 'personal AI supercomputer' laptop category that challenges Intel's x86 dominance.
iBuyPower launches the Pro AMD AI Halo Mini PC with Ryzen AI Max+ Pro 495, 128 GB RAM, dual USB4 and dual 10 GbE for local AI workloads.
Motorola Razr Ultra 2026 owners are receiving Android 17, which adds a programmable AI key, themed icons and enhanced security to the clamshell foldable.
Windows Central reviews the Razer Basilisk V4 Pro: still a top gaming mouse, but it ships with an out-of-the-box AI button binding the reviewer says nobody asked for.
An XDA writer runs an entire AI workflow on local hardware for a week, reporting surprising wins and frustrating limits that show what still needs the cloud.
Humanoid robot demos still fail to generalize to real homes and workplaces; The Robot Report argues better data and human judgment are needed to move beyond staged demos.
